name: 01331 · Athol, MA
findings: ZIP 01331 (Athol) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01331 (Athol) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 10 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
